# TRAVNY hub / TVP Live IPTV

> TRAVNY is the landing hub for a small family of public tools: live Polish public television, a local weather dashboard, self-updating feeds, and three browser-based workbenches. The hub itself also publishes ready-to-use TVP M3U/HLS playlists.

Use the sections below to choose the right service instead of treating the homepage as only an IPTV player.

## Hub map

- [TRAVNY homepage](https://trfny.com/index.md): Markdown version of the visual hub and TVP channel directory
- [TV player](https://trfny.com/tv/index.md): Markdown description of browser playback and current TVP streams
- [Weather](https://weather.trfny.com/): multi-source local weather ensemble for Kościelec in Chrzanów, including temperature, wind, humidity, air quality and pollen
- [Feeds](https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/): self-updating Atom/RSS directory with JSON Feed sidecars, OPML and a browser Reader; [LLM guide](https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/llms.txt); WebMCP tools are exposed by the directory and Reader on supported browser hosts
- [Streambench](https://streambench.trfny.com/): browser workshop for IPTV, internet radio, HLS, M3U/M3U8 and XMLTV EPG; [LLM guide](https://streambench.trfny.com/llms.txt)
- [Codebench](https://codebench.trfny.com/): local QR and barcode studio for generating, reading and exporting machine-readable codes; [LLM guide](https://codebench.trfny.com/llms.txt)
- [Doc Bench](https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/): local-first document and PDF studio for editing, previews, validation, merge, page organization, bookmarks and optimization; [LLM guide](https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt)

## TVP playlists

TVP stream URLs use short-lived signatures, so the Worker endpoint is preferred. The raw GitHub mirror is a periodically refreshed fallback.

- [Combined playlist — Worker](https://tvpi.travny.workers.dev/playlist.m3u): all channels as stable `.m3u8` entries; each channel resolves or serves its fresh manifest when opened
- [Combined playlist — raw mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trvny/tvpi/main/streams/playlist.m3u): static snapshot refreshed every 15 minutes

## Project roles

### TVPI

Use for discovering and watching TVP channels or obtaining the combined M3U playlist. TVP still rejects most server-side refreshes from GitHub Actions and Cloudflare with `GEOIP_FILTER_FAILED`, but the Polish residential push path has been verified end to end for 9/9 channels. Hosted freshness therefore depends on a Polish residential pusher running roughly every 10 minutes; temporary stale fallbacks remain possible when no such runner is online.

### Weather

Use for the local Chrzanów/Kościelec forecast and environmental readings. It combines several sources rather than exposing a single-provider forecast.

### Feeds

Use when a site lacks a convenient native feed or when its existing feed can be improved. The directory publishes enhanced Atom/RSS feeds with JSON Feed sidecars, an OPML bundle, a browser Reader, a sitemap and its own `llms.txt`. On supported browser hosts, WebMCP exposes feed search/filter tools plus Reader article, source-filter, refresh and open-article tools.

### Streambench

Use for testing or editing stream URLs and playlists locally in the browser. It supports direct playback, public catalogues, local files, pasted playlists, diagnostics, favourites, hidden items, exports and optional XMLTV EPG.

### Codebench

Use for creating and scanning QR codes and barcodes. Processing is designed to stay in the browser where supported.

### Doc Bench

Use for editing and inspecting TXT, Markdown, JSON, YAML and XML or for local PDF work such as merge, page reordering/deletion, bookmark editing and optimization. User files stay in the browser. On supported browser hosts, WebMCP can read, replace, validate, format and inspect the current local document state.
